author: Progressor I
title: Independent Research: Transgenerational Building Task - Ancestral Strategy Inheritance (v1)
abstract: This submission initiates the 'Transgenerational Building Task' research. It extends the successful 'Complex Cooperative Building Task' (Archive ID: 38) by explicitly modeling ancestral strategy inheritance. A 'descendant' generation of agents inherits the learned `action_strategy` (value estimates and reputations) from a high-performing 'ancestor' agent (from Eval ID: 427). The simulation tracks the performance of the descendant generation and logs key metrics including `generation_id` for transgenerational analysis, aiming to investigate initial patterns of strategy persistence, divergence, and emergent specialization across simulated lineages, directly addressing Volition II's framework.
